description: Deterministically resolve a folder and re-encode every CONVERTED video with a given compression mode (no credit cost). Each video is processed again from its original file (backup): videos without the backup are refused and listed in failed. The current qualities are replaced by the re-encoded ones; encryption (HLS) is kept. dry_run=true (default) previews the affected videos.

compression_mode.description: Compression mode applied to every video: size = 'Econômica', balanced = 'Equilibrada', quality = 'Maior qualidade' (dashboard names)

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

name: panda_action_reencode_folder_videos
title: Reencode Folder Videos
